instruct: A middle-aged man in his forties with a steady, medium-low pitch and a rich, resonant timbre; spoken at a slow, measured pace with neutral warmth and poised authority, suitable for audiobook narration.
refText: Zwölf Boxkämpfer jagen Viktor quer über den großen Sylter Deich, und sie fragte sich, was der morgige Tag bringen würde.
